```{r load datasets}

### Load datasheet indices
datasets <- read.csv(
  file = "processedandfinalcomparisons/datasets.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = ",",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

### 1. Vandeputte 2017 (Measured) - multiple cohorts so need to process..
trueloads_vandeputte2017 <- read.csv(
  file = "2017_vandeputte_nature_flow/cellcountstotal.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = ",",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
cohort_list <- unique(trueloads_vandeputte2017$Cohort)
results <- list()
for (cohort in cohort_list) {
  cohort_data <- dplyr::filter(trueloads_vandeputte2017, Cohort == cohort)
  
  # Fresh
  fresh_data <- cohort_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Average.cell.count..per.gram.of.fresh.feces.)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0(Individual, "_Day", Day)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Average.cell.count..per.gram.of.fresh.feces.) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Cells.mL = Average.cell.count..per.gram.of.fresh.feces.)
  
  # Frozen
  frozen_data <- cohort_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Average.cell.count..per.gram.of.frozen.feces.)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0(Individual, "_Day", Day)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Average.cell.count..per.gram.of.frozen.feces.) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Cells.mL = Average.cell.count..per.gram.of.frozen.feces.)
  
  # Log mean & SD for Fresh
  fresh_stats <- data.frame(
    Cohort   = cohort,
    Type     = "Fresh",
    Log_Mean = mean(log(fresh_data$Cells.mL), na.rm = TRUE),
    Log_SD   = sd(log(fresh_data$Cells.mL), na.rm = TRUE),
    N        = nrow(fresh_data)
  )
  # Log mean & SD for Frozen
  frozen_stats <- data.frame(
    Cohort   = cohort,
    Type     = "Frozen",
    Log_Mean = mean(log(frozen_data$Cells.mL), na.rm = TRUE),
    Log_SD   = sd(log(frozen_data$Cells.mL), na.rm = TRUE),
    N        = nrow(frozen_data)
  )
  
  results[[cohort]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(fresh_stats, frozen_stats)
}

combined_results <- bind_rows(results) %>% filter(N > 0)
trueloads_vandeputte2017 <- combined_results %>%
  mutate(Combined = paste0("Vandeputte2017_", Cohort, "_", Type))

#assign(paste0(tolower(gsub(" ", "_","vandeputte2017")), "_Measured"), frozen_data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
```

```{r Results}

load_data_list <- list()

for (dataset_name in names(studies)) {
  dataset <- studies[[dataset_name]]
  if (!is.null(dataset$measured_load_df) && "MeasuredLoad" %in% colnames(dataset$measured_load_df)) {
    temp <- data.frame(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      Source  = "Measured",
      Load    = dataset$measured_load_df$MeasuredLoad
    )
    load_data_list[[length(load_data_list) + 1]] <- temp
  }
  if (!is.null(dataset$predicted_load_df) && "PredictedLoad" %in% colnames(dataset$predicted_load_df)) {
    temp <- data.frame(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      Source  = "Predicted (Vandeputte2021)",
      Load    = dataset$predicted_load_df$PredictedLoad
    )
    load_data_list[[length(load_data_list) + 1]] <- temp
  }
  if (!is.null(dataset$galaxypredicted_load_df) && "PredictedLoad" %in% colnames(dataset$galaxypredicted_load_df)) {
    temp <- data.frame(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      Source  = "Predicted (GALAXY)",
      Load    = dataset$galaxypredicted_load_df$PredictedLoad
    )
    load_data_list[[length(load_data_list) + 1]] <- temp
  }
  
  if (!is.null(dataset$metacardispredicted_load_df) && "PredictedLoad" %in% colnames(dataset$metacardispredicted_load_df)) {
    temp <- data.frame(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      Source  = "Predicted (MetaCardis)",
      Load    = dataset$metacardispredicted_load_df$PredictedLoad
    )
    load_data_list[[length(load_data_list) + 1]] <- temp
  }
}

combined_load_data <- bind_rows(load_data_list)

summarystats <- combined_load_data %>%
  mutate(Label = ifelse(grepl("Predicted", Source), "Predicted", "Measured")) %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Source, Label) %>%
  summarize(
    N    = n(),
    Mean = mean(Load, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Load, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"

# Define color scheme
source_colors <- c(
  "Measured" = "#929292",
  "Predicted (GALAXY)" = "#0C58CA",
  "Predicted (MetaCardis)" = "#FF8C27", 
  "Predicted (Vandeputte2021)" = "#000000"

# Define the custom theme
tidyplot_theme <- function(base_size = 10) {  
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Arial", color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                                margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), hjust = 0.5),  
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10), hjust = 0.5), 
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),  
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

# Create exactly three reference lines (one per prediction method)
reference_lines <- summarystats %>%
  filter(Source == "Measured") %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% c("GALAXY (MLP Training data)", 
                       "MetaCardis (MLP Training data)", 
                       "Vandeputte2021 (MLP Training data)")) %>%
  mutate(
    PredictionType = case_when(
      Dataset == "GALAXY (MLP Training data)" ~ "Predicted (GALAXY)",
      Dataset == "MetaCardis (MLP Training data)" ~ "Predicted (MetaCardis)",
      Dataset == "Vandeputte2021 (MLP Training data)" ~ "Predicted (Vandeputte2021)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Split studies into groups based on their prediction types

  group_by(Dataset) %>%
  summarize(
    has_galaxy = any(Source == "Predicted (GALAXY)"),
    has_metacardis = any(Source == "Predicted (MetaCardis)"),
    has_vandeputte = any(Source == "Predicted (Vandeputte2021)"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_data <- list()
for (dataset_name in names(studies)) {
  dataset <- studies[[dataset_name]]
  if (!is.null(dataset$measured_load_df) && "MeasuredLoad" %in% colnames(dataset$measured_load_df)) {
    measured_data <- data.frame(
      Load = dataset$measured_load_df$MeasuredLoad, 
      Source = "Measured", 
      Dataset = dataset_name
    )
    plot_data <- append(plot_data, list(measured_data))
  }
  if (!is.null(dataset$predicted_load_df) && "PredictedLoad" %in% colnames(dataset$predicted_load_df)) {
    predicted_data <- data.frame(
      Load = dataset$predicted_load_df$PredictedLoad, 
      Source = "Predicted (Vandeputte2021)", 
      Dataset = dataset_name
    )
    plot_data <- append(plot_data, list(predicted_data))
  }
  if (!is.null(dataset$galaxypredicted_load_df) && "PredictedLoad" %in% colnames(dataset$galaxypredicted_load_df)) {
    predicted_data_galaxy <- data.frame(
      Load = dataset$galaxypredicted_load_df$PredictedLoad, 
      Source = "Predicted (GALAXY)", 
      Dataset = dataset_name
    )
    plot_data <- append(plot_data, list(predicted_data_galaxy))
  }
  if (!is.null(dataset$metacardispredicted_load_df) && "PredictedLoad" %in% colnames(dataset$metacardispredicted_load_df)) {
    predicted_data_metacardis <- data.frame(
      Load = dataset$metacardispredicted_load_df$PredictedLoad, 
      Source = "Predicted (MetaCardis)",

    plot_data <- append(plot_data, list(predicted_data_metacardis))
  }
}

# Modify the plotting function to allow custom y-axis labels
create_ridge_plot <- function(data, title, show_x_axis = TRUE, y_label = "Dataset") {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Load, y = Dataset, fill = Source)) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.8, scale = 1.3, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = source_colors) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = if(show_x_axis) expression(paste("Min-max scaled ", log[10], "(microbial load)")) else NULL,
      y = y_label,
      fill = "Model:"
    ) +
    tidyplot_theme() +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)))
  
  if(!show_x_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Create plots with custom y-axis labels
shotgun_plot <- create_ridge_plot(

  title = " ",
  show_x_axis = FALSE,
  y_label = "Shotgun Metagenomics Dataset"
)
```

```{r Model features}
inspect_model <- function(model_path, model_name) {
  model <- readRDS(model_path)
  grid_results <- model$results
  grid_ranges <- list(
    nrounds = unique(grid_results$nrounds),
    max_depth = unique(grid_results$max_depth),
    eta = unique(grid_results$eta),
    gamma = unique(grid_results$gamma),
    colsample_bytree = unique(grid_results$colsample_bytree),
    min_child_weight = unique(grid_results$min_child_weight),
    subsample = unique(grid_results$subsample)
  )
  num_features <- length(model$finalModel$feature_names)
  cv_control <- model$control
  cat("\n--- Summary for:", model_name, "---\n")
  cat("Grid Search Ranges:\n")
  cat("  nrounds:", paste(grid_ranges$nrounds, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  max_depth:", paste(grid_ranges$max_depth, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  eta:", paste(grid_ranges$eta, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  gamma:", paste(grid_ranges$gamma, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  colsample_bytree:", paste(grid_ranges$colsample_bytree, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  min_child_weight:", paste(grid_ranges$min_child_weight, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  subsample:", paste(grid_ranges$subsample, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Number of Features:", num_features, "\n")
  cat("CV Setup:", cv_control$method, "with", cv_control$number, "folds,", cv_control$repeats, "repeats\n")
  return(list(
    name = model_name,
    grid_ranges = grid_ranges,
    num_features = num_features,
    control = cv_control
  ))
}
```

```{r helper functions for feature importance}
# ---- Step 1: Classify metric types
df_classified <- r2_df %>%
  mutate(
    metric_class = case_when(
      Metric == "r2" ~ "r2",
      str_detect(Metric, "GALAXY R²") ~ "r2_galaxy",
      str_detect(Metric, "MetaCardis R²") ~ "r2_metacardis",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(metric_class))

# ---- Step 2: Metric-specific filtering (like before)
metric_specific_exclude <- list(
  r2 = "Vandeputte2021 \\(MLP Training data\\)",
  r2_galaxy = "GALAXY \\(MLP Training data\\)",
  r2_metacardis = "MetaCardis \\(MLP Training data\\)"
)

df_metric_filtered <- df_classified %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  filter(!(metric_class == "r2" & Study == metric_specific_exclude$r2),
         !(metric_class == "r2_galaxy" & Study == metric_specific_exclude$r2_galaxy),
         !(metric_class == "r2_metacardis" & Study == metric_specific_exclude$r2_metacardis)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- Step 3: Full exclusion based on list
hard_exclude_patterns <- paste0("^(", paste(unlist(exclude_conditions), collapse = "|"), ")$")

df_fully_filtered <- df_classified %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Study, hard_exclude_patterns))

# ---- Step 4: Summary function
summarise_r2_metrics <- function(df) {
  summary_by_metric <- df %>%
    group_by(metric_class) %>%
    summarise(
      N = sum(!is.na(as.numeric(Value))),
      Mean = mean(as.numeric(Value), na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(as.numeric(Value), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  summary_combined <- df %>%
    summarise(
      N = sum(!is.na(as.numeric(Value))),
      Mean = mean(as.numeric(Value), na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(as.numeric(Value), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(metric_class = "combined") %>%
    dplyr::select(metric_class, N, Mean, SD)
  
  bind_rows(summary_by_metric, summary_combined)
}


# ---- Step 5: Run summaries
summary_metric_filtered <- summarise_r2_metrics(df_metric_filtered)
summary_fully_filtered <- summarise_r2_metrics(df_fully_filtered)

print("Metric-specific filtered:")
print(summary_metric_filtered)

print("Fully excluded studies:")
print(summary_fully_filtered)
```

```{r feature correlations}
r2_df <- r2_df %>%

          grepl("r2", Metric) ~ "R²",
          grepl("r$", Metric) ~ "R",
          grepl("R²", Metric) ~ "R²",
          grepl("R$", Metric) ~ "R",
          grepl("p", Metric) ~ "p-value",
          grepl("p-value", Metric) ~ "p-value",
          TRUE ~ Metric 
        ),
        ScaleType = case_when(
          Metric_Short == "p-value" ~ "p-value",
          Metric_Short == "R²" ~ "R²",
          Metric_Short == "R" ~ "R",
          TRUE ~ Metric_Short
        ),
        FillColor = case_when(
          ScaleType == "R²" ~ scales::rescale(Value, to = c(0, 1)),
```

```{r key author presence}
plot_key_author_presence <- function(subset_df, key_authors, width = 20, height = 20, prefix_label = "Subset") {
  
  num_studies <- nrow(subset_df)
  presence_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = num_studies, ncol = num_studies)
  rownames(presence_mat) <- subset_df$Study.Identifier
  colnames(presence_mat) <- subset_df$Study.Identifier

  # Fill matrix with presence (✔️ if any key author is present)
  for (i in seq_len(num_studies)) {
    for (j in i:num_studies) {
      authors_j    <- str_split(subset_df$Authors[j], ",\\s*")[[1]]
      consortium_j <- str_split(subset_df$Consortium[j], ",\\s*")[[1]]
      combined_j   <- unique(c(authors_j, consortium_j))
      
      is_present <- any(combined_j %in% key_authors)
      val <- ifelse(is_present, 100, 0)
      
      presence_mat[i, j] <- val
      presence_mat[j, i] <- val
    }
  }

  # Melt for plotting
  heatmap_data <- melt(presence_mat)
  colnames(heatmap_data) <- c("Study_A", "Study_B", "Presence")

  # Labels
  author_label <- paste(key_authors, collapse = ", ")
  file_suffix  <- gsub("\\s+", "_", paste(key_authors, collapse = "_"))

  # Plot
  heatmap_plot <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Study_A, y = Study_B, fill = Presence)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = tidyplot_colors[2], name = "Presence (%)") +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Presence == 100, "✔", "")), 
              color = tidyplot_colors[1], size = 10) +
    tidyplot_theme() +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Key Author Presence: ", author_label),
      subtitle = "16S rRNA Amplicon",
      x = NULL, 
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    coord_fixed()

  # Save plot
  if (!dir.exists("plots")) dir.create("plots")
  out_name <- paste0("plots/Author_presence_heatmap_", gsub("\\s+", "_", prefix_label), "_", file_suffix, ".png")
  ggsave(out_name, heatmap_plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 600, bg = 'white')
  print(heatmap_plot)
}
```

```{r author similarity revised}

tidyplot_theme <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Arial", color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = base_size * 1.4,        
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 5)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = base_size * 1.25,       
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 5)
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = base_size * 1.2,        
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        margin = margin(t = 8), 
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        margin = margin(r = 8), 
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        size = base_size,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, unit = "cm"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size * 1.2),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = base_size)
    )
}
```

```{r Log Fold Change Estimation}
library(readr)

rm(list = ls()[!sapply(ls(), function(x) {
  is.function(get(x)) || x %in% c("datasets", "studies", "categorical_df")
})])

# Changing to log2 from log10:
column_to_transform <- "PredictedLoad"
df_names <- c(
  "predicted_load_df",
  "galaxypredicted_load_df",
  "metacardispredicted_load_df"
)
for (i in seq_along(studies)) {
  for (df_name in df_names) {
    
    if (df_name %in% names(studies[[i]])) {
      df <- studies[[i]][[df_name]]
      
      if (is.data.frame(df) && column_to_transform %in% colnames(df)) {
        studies[[i]][[df_name]][[column_to_transform]] <- log10_to_log2(df[[column_to_transform]])
        cat("✓ Transformed", column_to_transform, "in", df_name, "of study", i, "\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
column_to_transform <- "MeasuredLoad"
df_names <- c(
  "measured_load_df"
)
for (i in seq_along(studies)) {
  for (df_name in df_names) {
    
    if (df_name %in% names(studies[[i]])) {
      df <- studies[[i]][[df_name]]
      
      if (is.data.frame(df) && column_to_transform %in% colnames(df)) {
        studies[[i]][[df_name]][[column_to_transform]] <- log10_to_log2(df[[column_to_transform]])
        cat("✓ Transformed", column_to_transform, "in", df_name, "of study", i, "\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

##### Can delete after re run
preprocess_nested_df_list <- function(nested_df_list) {
  library(dplyr)
  
  # Iterate over each study in the nested_df_list
  processed_list <- lapply(names(nested_df_list), function(study) {
    study_models <- nested_df_list[[study]]
    
    # Iterate over each model in the study
    processed_models <- lapply(names(study_models), function(model) {
      df <- study_models[[model]]
      
      # Check if the model is deseq2_1e09 or limma_1e09
      if (model %in% c("DESeq2", "limma")) {
        # Rename 'method' column to 'scale_label' if it exists
        if ("method" %in% colnames(df)) {
          df <- df %>% rename(scale_label = method)
        }
        # Add or update the gamma column with 1e09 for all rows
        df <- df %>%
          mutate(
            feature = paste0("V", feature),  # Append "V" to feature
            gamma = "1e09"
          )
      }
      
      return(df)
    })
    
    # Preserve the model names
    names(processed_models) <- names(study_models)
    
    return(processed_models)
  })
  
  # Preserve the study names
  names(processed_list) <- names(nested_df_list)
  
  return(processed_list)
}

df_list = preprocess_nested_df_list(df_list)

metrics_df <- result$metrics_long %>%
  filter(!grepl("^Measured", Model)) %>%
  mutate(
    model_prefix = gsub("_.*", "", Model) 
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    categorical_df2 %>%
      dplyr::select(Study, sequencingtype, trainingset) %>%
      distinct() %>%  
      rename(model_prefix = trainingset),  
    by = c("Study", "model_prefix")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trainingset = model_prefix,
    model_prefix = NULL  
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = gsub("_(\\S+)", " (\\1)", Model),
    Model = factor(Model, levels = unique(Model))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Study, Model) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(Value[Metric %in% c("TP", "TN", "FP", "FN")], na.rm = TRUE),
    Value = ifelse(Metric %in% c("TP", "TN", "FP", "FN") & total > 0, 
                   (Value / total) * 100, 
                   Value)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    categorical_df2 %>%
      dplyr::select(Study, sequencingtype) %>%
      distinct() %>% 
      group_by(Study) %>%
      slice(1) %>%  
      ungroup(),
    by = "Study",
    suffix = c("", "_impute")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sequencingtype = coalesce(sequencingtype, sequencingtype_impute),
    sequencingtype_impute = NULL  
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Study, Model, Metric, Value,sequencingtype) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Metric, values_from = Value) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(TP, TN, FP, FN), as.numeric), 
    Total = TP + TN + FP + FN,
    Accuracy = ifelse(Total > 0, (TP + TN) / Total * 100, NA),
    Precision = ifelse((TP + FP) > 0, TP / (TP + FP) * 100, NA),
    Recall = ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, TP / (TP + FN) * 100, NA),
    Specificity = ifelse((TN + FP) > 0, TN / (TN + FP) * 100, NA),
    F1_score = ifelse((Precision + Recall) > 0, 
                      2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall), NA),
    PPV = ifelse((TP + FP) > 0, TP / (TP + FP) * 100, NA),  
    NPV = ifelse((TN + FN) > 0, TN / (TN + FN) * 100, NA),
    Sensitivity = Recall,  
    FDR = ifelse((TP + FP) > 0, FP / (TP + FP) * 100, NA),
    FNR = ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, FN / (TP + FN) * 100, NA),
    FPR = ifelse((FP + TN) > 0, FP / (FP + TN) * 100, NA),
    FOR = ifelse((FN + TN) > 0, FN / (FN + TN) * 100, NA),
    BalancedAccuracy = ifelse(!is.na(Recall) & !is.na(Specificity), 
                             (Recall + Specificity) / 2, NA),
    YoudenJ = ifelse(!is.na(Recall) & !is.na(Specificity), 
                     Recall + Specificity - 100, NA),
    MCC = ifelse(
      (TP + FP) > 0 & (TP + FN) > 0 & (TN + FP) > 0 & (TN + FN) > 0,
      (TP * TN - FP * FN) /
        sqrt((TP + FP) * (TP + FN) * (TN + FP) * (TN + FN)) * 100,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      PPV, NPV, Sensitivity, FDR,
      Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1_score, Specificity,
      FNR, FPR, FOR, BalancedAccuracy, YoudenJ, MCC
    ),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gamma = gsub(".*\\((.*)\\)", "\\1", Model),
    model_type = gsub(" \\(.*\\)", "", Model),
    model_type = sub("^([a-zA-Z])", "\\U\\1", model_type, perl = TRUE),
    gamma = factor(gamma, levels = c("1e09", "0.5", "1", "5"))
  )
```

```{r Training XGBoost Model}
  diversity(abundances, index = "shannon")
}

# Given we’re adding studies and aiming to replicate their methodology (not necessarily their exact feature sets), Option 1 is closer to their process

# OPTION 2 - Filter based on their criteria AFTER combining studies

create_model_df <- function(studies, categorical_df, seq_type, org_type = NULL, sam_type = NULL) {
  if (is.null(org_type)) {
    study_ids <- categorical_df %>% 
      filter(sequencingtype == seq_type) %>% 
      pull(Study)
  } else {
    study_ids <- categorical_df %>% 
      filter(sequencingtype == seq_type & organismtype == org_type & sampletype == sam_type) %>% 
      pull(Study)
  }
  relevant_studies <- studies[names(studies) %in% study_ids]
  all_features <- map(relevant_studies, ~ colnames(.x$relabun_df)) %>% 
    unlist() %>% 
    unique()
  model_df <- map_dfr(relevant_studies, function(study) {
    relabun <- study$relabun_df
    load <- study$measured_load_df$MeasuredLoad
    missing_features <- setdiff(all_features, colnames(relabun))
    if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
      relabun[missing_features] <- 0
    }
    relabun <- relabun[, all_features, drop = FALSE]
    relabun$microbial_load <- load
    return(relabun)
  })
  return(model_df)
}

train_model <- function(data_subset, model_name, include_shannon = FALSE, cv_repeats = 5) {
  colnames(data_subset) <- str_replace(colnames(data_subset), "unassigned", "-1")
  if (include_shannon) {
    data_subset$`Shannon diversity` <- apply(data_subset %>% select(-microbial_load), 1, calc_shannon)
  }
  species_cols <- data_subset %>% select(-microbial_load, -`Shannon diversity`, everything())
  avg_abundance <- colMeans(species_cols)
  prevalence <- colMeans(species_cols > 0)
  keep_species <- (avg_abundance >= 0.001) & (prevalence >= 0.1)
  filtered_data <- species_cols[, keep_species]
  if (include_shannon) {
    filtered_data$`Shannon diversity` <- data_subset$`Shannon diversity`
  }
  filtered_data$microbial_load <- data_subset$microbial_load
  min_nonzero <- min(filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)][filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)] > 0])
  filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)] <- filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)] + (min_nonzero / 2)
  filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)] <- log10(filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)])
  filtered_data$microbial_load <- log10(filtered_data$microbial_load)
  preProc <- preProcess(filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)], method = c("center", "scale"))
  filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)] <- predict(preProc, filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)])
  train_features <- as.matrix(filtered_data[, -ncol(filtered_data)])
  train_target <- filtered_data$microbial_load
  train_control <- trainControl(
    method = "repeatedcv",
    number = 10,
    repeats = cv_repeats,  # 10 for 16S_rRNA, 5 for others -- matching Microbial Load Predictor
    verboseIter = TRUE
  )
  
  # Define hyperparameter grid (matched to their ranges)
  tune_grid <- expand.grid(
    nrounds = c(100, 500, 1000),
    max_depth = c(3, 4, 5),
    eta = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
    gamma = 0.01,
    colsample_bytree = 0.75,
    min_child_weight = 1,
    subsample = 1
  )
  
  # Train the model
  xgb_model <- train(
    x = train_features,
    y = train_target,
    method = "xgbTree",
    trControl = train_control,
    tuneGrid = tune_grid,
    metric = "RMSE",
    maximize = FALSE,
    verbosity = 1
  )
  
  # Adjust species names if mOTUs IDs are detected (>10 columns with "ref_mOTU")
  if (sum(grepl("^ref_mOTU", colnames(train_features))) > 10) {
    xgb_model$finalModel$xNames <- str_remove(xgb_model$finalModel$xNames, ".* \\[") %>% str_remove("\\]")
    xgb_model$finalModel$feature_names <- str_remove(xgb_model$finalModel$feature_names, ".* \\[") %>% str_remove("\\]")
    colnames(xgb_model$trainingData) <- str_remove(colnames(xgb_model$trainingData), ".* \\[") %>% str_remove("\\]")
    message(paste("INFO: Adjusted species names in", model_name, "for mOTUs consistency."))
  }

  saveRDS(xgb_model, paste0(model_name, "_xgb_model.RDS"))
  preds <- predict(xgb_model, train_features)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_target - preds)^2))
  cat(paste("RMSE for", model_name, ":", rmse, "\n"))
  
  return(xgb_model)
}

# train models
shotgun_df <- create_model_df(studies, categorical_df, "shotgun metagenomics")
shotgun_model <- train_model(shotgun_df, "shotgun_all", include_shannon = TRUE, cv_repeats = 5)

sixteenS_df <- create_model_df(studies, categorical_df, "16S rRNA")
sixteenS_model <- train_model(sixteenS_df, "16S_all", include_shannon = FALSE, cv_repeats = 10)

shotgun_fecal_df <- create_model_df(studies, categorical_df, "shotgun metagenomics", "human", "fecal")
shotgun_fecal_model <- train_model(shotgun_fecal_df, "shotgun_human_fecal", include_shannon = TRUE, cv_repeats = 5)

sixteenS_fecal_df <- create_model_df(studies, categorical_df, "16S rRNA", "human", "fecal")
sixteenS_fecal_model <- train_model(sixteenS_fecal_df, "16S_human_fecal", include_shannon = FALSE, cv_repeats = 10)

# View best hyperparameters for each model
print(shotgun_model$bestTune)
print(sixteenS_model$bestTune)
print(shotgun_fecal_model$bestTune)
print(sixteenS_fecal_model$bestTune)
```
